verdict.rationale: Galileo documents an official MCP server that connects AI IDEs like Cursor and VS Code/Copilot to its evaluation and observability platform. The listed MCP capabilities, though, are creating and managing datasets, running experiments, and setting up prompt templates, so only the eval/experiment part of the story is covered. Nothing shows an agent can query logged traces, spans, or production metrics through MCP or a documented query API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: documented MCP tools or API endpoints for querying traces/spans/sessions, programmatic access to metric values and eval results for debugging, a public API reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.
